gaps.sentence: ___ being remarkably fast, the new chip consumes far less power.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides + -ing' adds a further advantage; 'despite of' does not exist.

gaps.sentence: The economy has strengthened; ___, unemployment keeps rising.
gaps.explanation: Rising unemployment goes against the positive trend: however marks the contrast.

gaps.sentence: She speaks fluent Mandarin; ___, she reads classical Chinese.
gaps.explanation: 'Moreover' adds a further, even more remarkable achievement.

gaps.sentence: ___ the strike, trains will run a reduced service all week.
gaps.explanation: 'Because of the strike' gives the reason for the reduced service.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather cycle ___ wait twenty minutes for an unreliable bus.
gaps.explanation: 'Would rather... than...' is the fixed pattern for preferences.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.

gaps.sentence: The match was abandoned ___ the state of the pitch.
gaps.explanation: 'Owing to + noun' = because of, common in formal reporting.

gaps.sentence: ___ the theory is elegant, the data simply don't support it.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' grants the fact (the theory is elegant) before contradicting it.
